37500.meaning1: fixed in virtue; stable in ethical conduct
37500.meaning2: fixed in virtue; stable in ethical conduct

examples.text: dhuvasīlo'ti nibaddhasīlo. ṭhitasīlo'ti patiṭṭhitasīlo.

37502.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of nibaddha

examples.text: nibaddhaṃ mama gehaṃ pavisatha, aham'eva catūhi paccayehi upaṭṭhahissāmī'ti theraṃ nimantetvā pakkāmi.

37506.commentary: (THa) satiyā taṃ nibandhissa nti gocar'ajjhattato bahi gantuṃ adento satiyottena kammaṭṭhānathambhe, cittakali, taṃ nibandhissāmi niyamessāmi.

examples.text: satiyā taṃ nibandhissaṃ, payutto te damessāmi, vīriyadhura-niggahito, na y'ito dūraṃ gamissase cittā'ti.

37511.meaning2: having bound, having urged, having importuned

37512.grammar: fut, reflx 1st sg of nibandhati, trans (+acc)
37512.meaning1: I myself will bind; I myself shall tie
37512.meaning2: I will bind by myself; I shall tie
37512.commentary: (THa) satiyā taṃ nibandhissa nti gocar'ajjhattato bahi gantuṃ adento satiyottena kammaṭṭhānathambhe, cittakali, taṃ nibandhissāmi niyamessāmi.

examples.text: satiyā taṃ nibandhissaṃ, payutto te damessāmi, vīriyadhura-niggahito, na'y'ito dūraṃ gamissase cittā'ti.

37515.meaning2: gutter, edge, of the eaves; shelter of the eaves(?)

examples.text: evaṃ laddhanibbacanassa paṃsukūlassa dhāraṇaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ, paṃsukūlaṃ sīlam'assā'ti paṃsukūliko, paṃsukūlikassa aṅgaṃ paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ.
kadā nu nāgo'va asaṅgacārī, padālaye kāmaguṇesu chandaṃ, nibbajjayaṃ sabbasubhaṃ nimittaṃ, jhāne yuto taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

37521.commentary: (ANa) nibbattatelakan'ti vinivattitatelaṃ. nāliyasākan'ti sālipiṭṭhena saddhiṃ madditvā jīrak'ādisaṃyutte sappimhi pacitvā catumadhurena yojetvā vāsaṃ gāhāpetvā ṭhapitaṃ nāliyasākaṃ.

examples.text: sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti. manāpaṃ me, bhante, nibbaṭṭatelakaṃ nāliyasākaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
madhu nāma makkhikāmadhu. phāṇitaṃ nāma ucchumhā nibbattaṃ.

so hi yasmā raho paṭicchanne ṭhāne lañjaṃ gahetvā kūṭavinicchayena pākaṭaṃ dosaṃ karonto sāmike assāmike akāsi, tasm'āssa rahassaṃ aṅgaṃ pākaṭaṃ nibbattaṃ. yasmā daṇḍaṃ paṭṭhapento paresaṃ asayhaṃ bhāraṃ āropesi, tasm'āssa rahassaṃ aṅgaṃ asayhabhāro hutvā nibbattaṃ.
yathā'pi mūle anupaddave daḷhe, chinno'pi rukkho punareva rūhati, evam'pi taṇh'ānusaye anūhate, nibbattatī dukkham'idaṃ punappunaṃ.
ayaṃ māṇavo mayi cittaṃ pasādetvā kālaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsadevaloke tiṃsayojanike kanakavimāne nibbattissati.

37530.synonym: upapajjati, jāyatī, pabhavati, vuppajjati, sañjāyati, samudayati, samudeti
37530.commentary: (ANa) yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattatī'ti yasmiṃ ṭhāne assa lobhajakammavato puggalassa attabhāvo nibbattati, khandhā pātubhavanti.

examples.text: yaṃ, bhikkhave, lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ, yatth'assa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati.

37531.commentary: (ANa) nibbattatelakan'ti vinivattitatelaṃ. nāliyasākan'ti sālipiṭṭhena saddhiṃ madditvā jīrak'ādisaṃyutte sappimhi pacitvā catumadhurena yojetvā vāsaṃ gāhāpetvā ṭhapitaṃ nāliyasākaṃ.

examples.text: sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti. manāpaṃ me, bhante, nibbattatelakaṃ nāliyasākaṃ, taṃ me bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā'ti. paṭiggahesi bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.

37532.construction:
nī + √vatt > batt + ta + tta
nibbatta + tta

examples.text: samantato aṭṭhakosaṃ, passissati ayaṃ sadā, devalokā cavantassa, nibbattantassa jantuno.

sāvako'pi khīṇ'āsavo sāvakabodhiyā hetubhūte puññasambhāre sambharanto pubbayogaṃ pubbacariyaṃ gatapaccāgatavattaṃ pūrento carimabhave nibbattanto anukkamena viññutaṃ patvā saṃsāre ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajjāya cetayamāno pabbajjaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā sīl'ādīni paripūrento dhutadhamme samādāya…

37538.meaning2: with the seed removed; with the seed able to be regrown
37538.commentary: (VINt) nibbattabījan'ti nibbattaniyan'ti nibbattaṃ, nipubba vatu vattanetimasmā tappaccayo, nibbattaṃ bījaṃ yassa taṃ nibbattabījaṃ, bījaṃ nibbattetvā visuṃ katvā paribhuñjitabbaṃ amba-panas'ādi.

37540.meaning2: visible marks of a great man; arisen characteristics of a great being

examples.text: katamā ca, bhikkhave, jāti? yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti nibbatti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, jāti.

37545.meaning1: arose; came into being; was born

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni pubbe attanā katāni pāpakāni kammāni saṃkilesikāni ponobhavikāni sadarāni dukkhavipākāni āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇikāni, tesaṃ vipāko mā nibbattī'ti n'atthi koci pāṭibhogo, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ.

37550.meaning2: having been born, having resulted, having arisen

examples.text: mahāsatto hi tadā mahati uḷārabhoge kule nibbattitvā vuddhim'anvāya disāpāmokkhassa ācariyassa santike garuvāsaṃ vasanto sabbasippānaṃ nipphattiṃ patvā kulagharaṃ āgantvā
atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

37552.meaning2: should be produced, should be brought forth
37552.meaningLit: to cause to be proceeded out

37553.meaning2: produces; brings forth; brings into being

examples.text: sayaṃ samattaṃ karoti paripuṇṇaṃ karoti anomaṃ karoti aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ karoti janeti sañjaneti nibbatteti abhinibbattetī'ti

37554.meaning1: to bring about; to produce; to generate; to give rise (to)

examples.text: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā ekabījī hoti, ekaṃ'y'eva mānusakaṃ bhavaṃ nibbattetvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti.

37556.meaning1: having brought about; having produced; having given rise (to)

examples.text: evaṃ mahāsatto khuddakamakkhikāya pivanamattam'pi lohitaṃ anuppādetvā satta rājāno palāpetvā kaniṭṭhabhātaraṃ apaloketvā kāme pahāya isipabbajjaṃ pabbajitvā abhiññā ca samāpattiyo ca nibbattetvā jīvitapariyosāne brahmalok'ūpago ahosi.
mā ca te aggi nibbāyi. sace ca te aggi nibbāyeyya, ayaṃ vāsī imāni kaṭṭhāni idaṃ araṇisahitaṃ, aggiṃ nibbattetvā aggiṃ paricareyyāsī'ti.
bodhisatto ito c'ito ca olokento kañci adisvā vegena uṭṭhāya pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ān'āpāne pariggahetvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ nibbattesi.

37561.commentary: (THa) vanā nibbanam'āgatan'ti kilesavanato tabbirahitaṃ nibbanaṃ upagataṃ. (ANa) nibbanam'āgatan'ti kilesavanato nibbanaṃ kilesavanarahitaṃ nibbānaṃ āgataṃ sampattaṃ.

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.
vanaṃ chindatha mā rukkhaṃ, vanato jāyate bhayaṃ, chetvā vanañ'ca vanathañ'ca, nibbanā hotha bhikkhavo.

37562.commentary: (THa) vanā nibbanam'āgatan'ti kilesavanato tabbirahitaṃ nibbanaṃ upagataṃ. (ANa) nibbanam'āgatan'ti kilesavanato nibbanaṃ kilesavanarahitaṃ nibbānaṃ āgataṃ sampattaṃ.

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojan'ātītaṃ, vanā nibbanam'āgataṃ, kāmehi nekkhammarataṃ, muttaṃ selā'va kañcanaṃ.
vanaṃ chindatha mā rukkhaṃ, vanato jāyate bhayaṃ, chetvā vanañ'ca vanathañ'ca, nibbanā hotha bhikkhavo.

37563.meaning1: free from desire; free from craving

examples.text: yo nibbanatho van'ādhimutto, vanamutto vanam'eva dhāvati, taṃ puggalam'etha passatha, mutto bandhanam'eva dhāvati.

37564.commentary: (SNa) nibbasanānī'ti pubbe bhagavatā nivāsetvā apanītatāya evaṃladdhanāmāni. (SNt) nibbasanānī'ti ciranisevitavasanakiccāni, paribhogajiṇṇānī'ti attho.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ bhagavā etadavoca, jiṇṇo'si dāni tvaṃ, kassapa, garukāni ca te imāni sāṇāni paṃsukūlāni nibbasanāni.

37565.meaning2: carries out; carries along; flows out

37566.meaning1: (of mental defilement) is completely quenched; is entirely emancipated; is completely cooled

examples.text: khīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ nava n'atthi sambhavaṃ, virattacitt'āyatike bhavasmiṃ, te khīṇabījā avirūḷhichandā, nibbanti dhīrā yath'āyaṃ padīpo, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
pucchāmi taṃ ādiccabandhu, vivekaṃ santipadañ'ca mahesi, kathaṃ disvā nibbāti bhikkhu, anupādiyāno lokasmiṃ kiñci.
khīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ nava n'atthi sambhavaṃ, virattacitt'āyatike bhavasmiṃ, te khīṇabījā avirūḷhichandā, nibbanti dhīrā yath'āyaṃ padīpo, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
viññāṇassa nirodhena, taṇhākkhayavimuttino, pajjotass'eva nibbānaṃ, vimokkho hoti cetaso'ti.

37570.meaning1: (of mental defilement) complete quenching; total emancipation; complete cooling
37570.commentary: (MNa) yasmā pana dukkhañ'ca samudayo ca idaṃ ṭhānaṃ patvā nirujjhanti nappavattanti, tasmā yadidaṃ nibbānaṃ nāma (MNa) nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti taṇhāvānavirahitattā nibbānan'ti laddhanāmassa amatassa sacchikiriyāya, attapaccakkhatāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ, aṭṭh'aṅgiko ca maggānaṃ, khemaṃ amatagāminan'ti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, ariyā pariyesanā? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… attanā byādhidhammo samāno byādhidhamme ādīnavaṃ viditvā abyādhiṃ anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyesati

37572.meaning1: leading to putting out the fire; conducive to Nibbāna; going to Nibbāna

examples.text: etam'atthavasaṃ ñatvā, paṇḍito sīlasaṃvuto, nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ, khippam'eva visodhaye.

37573.meaning2: going to nibbāna; leading to nibbāna

37574.meaning1: leading to putting out the fire; conducive to Nibbāna

examples.text: vanappagumbe yatha phussit'agge, gimhānamāse paṭhamasmiṃ gimhe, tath'ūpamaṃ dhammavaraṃ adesayi, nibbānagāmiṃ paramaṃ hitāya, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, sakkāraṃ n'ābhinandeyya, vivekam'anubrūhaye.

37575.meaning1: going to Nibbāna; conducive to Nibbāna

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho nandiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kati nu kho, bho gotama, dhammā bhāvitā bahulīkatā nibbānaṅ'gamā honti nibbānaparāyanā nibbānapariyosānā'ti?

37577.meaning1: for the purpose of extinguishing; for the sake of quenching

examples.text: vimutti pana, bhante, kim'atthiyā'ti? vimutti kho, rādha, nibbān'atthā. nibbānaṃ pana, bhante, kim'atthiyan'ti?

37578.meaning1: condition of being liberated; state of Nibbāna

examples.text: dve'mā, bhikkhave, nibbānadhātuyo. katame dve? saupādisesā ca nibbānadhātu, anupādisesā ca nibbānadhātu.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bahū ce'pi bhikkhū anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbāyanti, na tena nibbānadhātuyā ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati

37580.meaning1: slanting to Nibbāna; sloping to Nibbāna; inclining to Nibbāna

examples.text: na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūtī bhavissatha, evaṃ tumhe, bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.

37581.meaningLit: discourse on the question about Nibbāna

37582.meaning1: connected with complete quenching; concerning total emancipation; related to Nibbāna
37582.commentary: (SNa) nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāyā'ti nibbānaṃ apadisitvā pavattāya. (UDa) nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāyā'ti amatadhātusannissitāya asaṅkhatadhātuyā pavedanavasena pavattāya.

examples.text: sāvatthinidānaṃ. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti. te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.

37583.meaning1: rooted in Nibbāna; established in Nibbāna

examples.text: sambādhe vā'pi vindanti, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, ye satiṃ paccalatthaṃsu, sammā te susamāhitā'ti.
das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.

37585.meaning1: state of Nibbāna; state of complete quenching
37585.commentary: (NIDD2) nibbānapadamaccutan'ti nibbānapadaṃ tāṇapadaṃ leṇapadaṃ saraṇapadaṃ abhayapadaṃ. (SNPa) nibbānapad'ābhipatthayāno'ti anupādisesaṃ khandhaparinibbānapadaṃ patthayamāno.

examples.text: te pabbajitvā sugatassa sāsane, bhāvetva bojjh'aṅgabalāni paṇḍitā, udaggacittā sumanā kat'indriyā, phusiṃsu nibbānapadaṃ asaṅkhatan'ti.
idha diṭṭhasutamutaviññātesu, piyarūpesu hemaka, chandarāgavinodanaṃ, nibbānapadam'accutaṃ.

37586.meaning1: slanting to Nibbāna; sloping to Nibbāna; inclining to Nibbāna

examples.text: na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūtī bhavissatha, evaṃ tumhe, bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.

37587.meaning1: culminating in Nibbāna; destined for Nibbāna
37587.commentary: (SNa) nibbānaparāyaṇan'ti nibbānaṃ paraṃ ayanam'assa parā gati, na tato paraṃ gacchatī'ti attho.

examples.text: accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

37588.meaning1: culminating in Nibbāna; destined for Nibbāna
37588.commentary: (MNa) nibbānaparāyanan'ti nibbānaṃ paraṃ ayanam'assa parā gati, na tato paraṃ gacchatī'ti attho.

examples.text: nibbānassa pan'āyye, kiṃ paṭibhāgo'ti? accayāsi, āvuso visākha, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhānaṃ pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, āvuso visākha, brahmacariyaṃ, nibbānaparāyanaṃ nibbānapariyosānaṃ.

37589.meaning1: culminating in Nibbāna; finishing with extinguishing; (or) having Nibbāna as conclusion
37589.commentary: (MNa) nibbānaṃ pariyosānaṃ avasānaṃ assā'ti nibbānapariyosānaṃ. (ANa) nibbānapariyosānā'ti ettha anupādisesā. anupādisesaṃ pattassa hi sabbe dhammā pariyosānappattā nāma honti

examples.text: samādhippamukhā sabbe dhammā, sat'ādhipateyyā sabbe dhammā, paññ'uttarā sabbe dhammā, vimuttisārā sabbe dhammā, amat'ogadhā sabbe dhammā, nibbānapariyosānā sabbe dhammā'ti.
accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

37592.meaning1: sloping to Nibbāna; inclining to Nibbāna; leading to Nibbāna

examples.text: nibbānapoṇañ'ca me mānasaṃ bhavissati, saṃyojanā ca me pahānaṃ gacchissanti, paramena ca sāmaññena samannāgato bhavissāmī'ti.
na āvaṭṭaggāho gahessati, na antopūtī bhavissatha, evaṃ tumhe, bhikkhave, nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.

37593.meaning1: one's own quenching; one's own going out

examples.text: sati kāyagatā upaṭṭhitā, chasu phass'āyatanesu saṃvuto, satataṃ bhikkhu samāhito, jaññā nibbānam'attano'ti.

37594.meaning1: personally experiencing liberation; intimate experience of the fire going out
37594.commentary: (KHPa) nikkhantaṃ vānato'ti nibbānaṃ, sacchikaraṇaṃ sacchikiriyā, nibbānassa sacchikiriyā nibbānasacchikiriyā.

examples.text: tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, ariyasaccāna dassanaṃ, nibbānasacchikiriyā ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

37595.meaning1: close to Nibbāna; on the verge of going out

examples.text: n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajhāyato, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.
vivekaññ'eva sikkhetha, etadariyānam'uttamaṃ, na tena seṭṭho maññetha, sa ve nibbānasantike.

37596.meaning1: conducive to complete quenching; supportive of total emancipation

examples.text: pavivekāya pītiyā samatikkamā, nirāmisassa sukhassa samatikkamā, adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya samatikkamā, santo'ham'asmi, nibbuto'ham'asmi, anupādāno'ham'asmī'ti samanupassati, addhā ayam'āyasmā nibbānasappāyaṃy'eva paṭipadaṃ abhivadati.

37597.meaningLit: discourse on the practice conducive to complete quenching

37599.meaning1: who causes one to attain Nibbāna
